scope: The May 2019 exterior of Minsk Holy Spirit Cathedral at 3 Cyril and Methodius Street, including its twin Baroque west towers, tall central nave, side aisles and polygonal apse. The neighboring former Bernardine convent, its connecting site walls, and cathedral interiors are outside the scope.

references.filename: 4408 Cathedral of Holy Spirit in Minsk.jpg

originalReview.notes: Wide northwest view shows both tall spires, matching lanterns and belfries, the tall gilded central icon panel, and the cathedral position above the streets below. Neighboring buildings are excluded.

references.filename: 20190526 145451 Cathedral of Holy Spirit in Minsk.jpg

originalReview.notes: Southwest ground-level elevation shows the white tiered facade, dark belfry recesses, stepped horizontal cornices, green standing-seam side roofs, dark plinth and south tower side door.

references.filename: 20190526 145700 Cathedral of Holy Spirit in Minsk.jpg

originalReview.notes: Central portal close view establishes the large arched timber door, divided upper light, dark curved canopy, gilt metal edging and paired icon panels. Ornament is interpreted as abstract geometry.

quallaSearch.notes: Three exact Qualla originals are first-party Rakoon CC0 releases from consecutive days in May 2019. They show the west and south front, both tower silhouettes, and the central portal. No supplemental imagery was needed.
